exact: hemolysis by symbiont of host RBCs
hemolysis by symbiont of host erythrocytes
hemolysis by symbiont of host red blood cells
regulation of cytolysis of host cells by symbiont

definition: The cytolytic destruction of red blood cells, with the release of intracellular hemoglobin, in the host organism by a symbiont. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated hemolysis of host erythrocyte
